text:
Jasper Lin: Hi folks  Jasper here, joining Eng-Platform today (remote, PST). Tiny intro: I keep a desk full of succulents and once propagated a cactus successfully. Quick setup q's: who should I DM for VPN/SSH and for MDM enrollment? Is BYOD allowed? Also where do I pick sticker designs and can I request an extra travel charger for visits to SF?

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Jasper!! :tada: Buddy = Priya Rao. Swag + shipping: fill https://redwood.company/swag-form and pick stickers there. BYOD allowed but requires MDM + FDE; if you want a company laptop we can ship one. Any dietary restrictions we should note for welcome box?

Jasper Lin: No dietary restrictions. I'll fill the swag form now. Thanks!

Noor (IT): Hey Jasper  welcome! For SSH/VPN open the IT portal (https://it.redwood/portal) and paste your public key. Quick commands: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "jasper@redwood.com"` then `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub`. After you submit the ticket we'll provision WireGuard and MDM. If you want the company charger, mention "travel charger" in the form and Zoe will coordinate shipping.

DevEx-Bot: Onboarding checklist created: ONB-9812 for Jasper Lin. Items: MDM enrollment, SSH key, Slack groups, repo ACLs, welcome box shipped.

Priya Rao: I'll DM you to set up a 30-min sync for repo access and pair-setup. If you prefer a minimal dotfiles setup run: `git clone git@github.com:redwood/dotfiles.git && ./install.sh --minimal`. We'll add you to #eng-platform and relevant repos after IT ticket clears.

Zoe (HR): Noted on the travel charger option. We'll ship the welcome box to the address on file  if you need it sent elsewhere, update the swag form. Also we do a small "plants & snacks" meetup in SF monthly, we'd love a succulents show-and-tell when you're in town :seedling: 

Ben (Eng): FYI macOS -> WireGuard has a known issue on Sonoma; ping me if you're on that OS and I can share a patched profile. Also recommend using Fish or Zsh with our dotfiles.

Flora (Design): welcome! if you want sticker recs, we have a small "sticker pack favorites" doc in the handbook. Succulent stickers are a team favorite :herb:

Jasper Lin: Awesome  submitting the IT portal ticket now and filling the swag form. Will DM Priya for the sync. Fun fact: I once rescued a 3cm succulent and it's now a 20cm happy boy. Looking forward to meeting y'all in SF sometime :grinning:
